description: Common constraint enforcement and foreign-key update/delete actions
sql: CREATE TABLE diff_fk_parents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, label TEXT CHECK (label <> ''));

CREATE TABLE diff_fk_children (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_code TEXT, CONSTRAINT diff_fk_children_parent_fkey FOREIGN KEY (parent_code) REFERENCES diff_fk_parents(code) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL);
INSERT INTO diff_fk_parents (id, code, label) VALUES ('p1', 'alpha', 'Alpha');
UPDATE diff_fk_parents SET code = 'beta' WHERE code = 'alpha';
SELECT parent_code FROM diff_fk_children WHERE id = 'c1';
SELECT parent_code FROM diff_fk_children WHERE id = 'c1';
SELECT constraint_name, constraint_type FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_name = 'diff_fk_children' ORDER BY constraint_name;
SELECT conname, contype FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'diff_fk_children_parent_fkey';
